facts.fact: The regulator ARN published on 17 July 2026 its report on Public Consultation No. 2, launched 4 June 2026 on the draft radio spectrum fees order, covering Orange Bissau's single contribution and which proposals it accepted or refused.

GNB.note: The article cites article 14 of Law 5/2010 but does not say it requires consultation.
